Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used a TMT6plex strategy with a MultiNotch MS3 acquisition method for improved quantification accuracy. No specific PTM enrichment (like phospho or ubiquitylome) was performed; it was an unbiased proteome-wide screen.

scope: Individual colon biopsies were weighed (the weights were ranged from 5.5 mg to 12 mg) and exposed to radioimmunoprecipitation assay (RIPA) lysis and extraction buffer (Thermo Scientific cat#89901) at 25 µL per mg for protein.
After that, biopsies were manually homogenized employing 1.5 mL tube sample pestles (RPI item#199228) and then freeze fractured for 1 cycle.

Samples were centrifuged at 20,000× g for 10 min to remove insoluble material. Supernatants were removed to a clean tube and then protein concentrations were determined using a BCA assay kit (Pierce cat#23227).

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by MS was derived from colonic mucosal biopsies processed using RIPA lysis buffer and homogenization to create a total protein extract (lysate), with only insoluble material removed by centrifugation.
